summary: Recent changes in the MP3 handling of Firefox focused on improving the MP3Demuxer, which is responsible for decoding MP3 audio files. A fix was implemented to address an issue with the average frame length calculation, preventing potential overflow errors that could disrupt smooth playback. This adjustment ensures that users experience **better stability and reliability in listening to their MP3 audio files**, enhancing overall audio quality without any noticeable disruptions. _While users may not see a direct change, the improvements contribute to a more robust audio experience._
